Diego Morales: Hey team — I handed in my resignation to my manager today. Last day will be 2024-06-30. I have a few questions about benefits/COBRA, final paycheck timing, and laptop return. Can someone confirm next steps?
Erin (People Ops): Thanks for the heads up, Diego — sorry to see you go. We've got a standard offboard checklist. Quick answers up front: 1) COBRA email will go out from BenefitAdmin within 3 business days, 2) final pay (including prorated salary & unused vacation) processed next payroll after last day, 3) IT will send a prepaid shipping label for company devices.
Diego Morales: Appreciate it. One nuance — my spouse is on the family health plan. How long does coverage continue and when does COBRA election window start?
Marta (HR): Coverage continues through your last day (2024-06-30) end of day. COBRA election window is 60 days from the date the election notice is mailed. BenefitAdmin mails the notice; sometimes they send an email first. Expect an email with subject: "Action required: COBRA election".
Diego Morales: OK thanks. I did enroll in the company's commuter/parking pre-tax plan — does that terminate immediately or is there any prorate?
Erin (People Ops): Commuter deductions stop with payroll that covers your last day. No separate proration needed — payroll & benefits will reconcile. Sam (Payroll) can confirm timing.
Sam (Payroll): Confirmed — final payroll run will include prorated salary + payout of accrued PTO. Any deductions for commuter/parking will stop on the last paycheck covering 6/30. If you expect any unusual items (expense reimbursements, bonus adjustments, equity settlements), DM me and we'll flag them.
Diego Morales: One other thing — I have RSUs vesting on 2024-07-15. Does offboard affect that?
Marta (HR): RSU vesting depends on your grant docs and termination reason. Usually termination of employment before a scheduled vest will prevent the vest unless the grant says otherwise. I'll loop in Compensation to confirm. Expect a direct email from comp-admin@redwood.com within 2 biz days.
Ashley - IT: Diego — for devices: please keep your laptop charged and on the network until you hand it to FedEx or drop it with the courier. We'll create a return ticket and send a prepaid label to the email on file. Also need to schedule account deprovision windows: we normally disable SSO access at 18:00 UTC on the employee's last day, and revoke GitHub/CI tokens the following morning to allow final handoff. Do you want GitHub access cut immediately at EOD or next morning?
Diego Morales: Prefer EOD disable for SSO, but keep GitHub for the next morning (07:00 UTC) so I can finish the migration notes with Asha.
Asha K.: Diego — I can carve out a 1-hr pair session tomorrow to do the knowledge transfer. I'll also pull the outstanding PRs list and write the doc for runbook ownership. When should we meet?
Diego Morales: Thanks Asha. Can we do 09:30 PT tomorrow (2024-06-28)? I'll make the runbook skeleton today.
Erin (People Ops): Noted. I'll add a line item to the offboard checklist: KT session with Asha on 2024-06-28 09:30 PT. Also adding "manager confirms repo owners & open PRs".
security-bot: Offboard ticket #OB-2024-178 created. Scheduled actions: SSO disable 2024-06-30T18:00:00Z, GitHub token revocation 2024-07-01T07:00:00Z, VPN certificate invalidation 2024-06-30T18:30:00Z.
Ashley - IT: Shipping label will be sent to diego.m@redwood.com today. When you drop the package, paste the tracking number in the offboard ticket so we can close the asset. Quick instructions: remove personal data, leave admin account intact, do not factory-reset (IT will handle imaging).
Diego Morales: Got it. Quick question on email & calendar: will my mailbox be forwarded to my manager or archived?
Erin (People Ops): Standard practice: mailbox is forwarded to manager for 30 days and then archived. If you need specific forwarding rules, tell us before EOD 6/30.
Diego Morales: I want the calendar access kept for the team to see meeting notes for two weeks, forwarding to my manager is fine.
Erin (People Ops): Done. Final steps for you: 1) confirm shipping label when it arrives, 2) fill short exit questionnaire (link sent in DM), 3) pick a time for a 30-min exit interview next week with People Ops. Preferred windows?
Diego Morales: Morning slots next week would be best (PT). Thanks everyone — I'll watch for the BenefitAdmin email and the shipping label.
Erin (People Ops): Thanks Diego — we'll follow up on the comp/RSU confirm and loop you in. Final checklist posted to ticket OB-2024-178. If anything urgent, ping @erin. :thumbsup:
